## Direct answer

Output depth: quick explanation

In plain language, the Analysis Data Model (ADaM) organizes clinical-study
data into analysis-ready datasets with traceable analysis variables.

## Why it matters

The structure helps reviewers understand how reported analyses relate to the
prepared study data; it does not by itself validate a study or result.

## Relationship to SDTM

SDTM commonly organizes standardized study data, while ADaM derives and
structures data for analysis with traceability back to relevant inputs.

## Uncertainty or next step

The next step is to review the study protocol, analysis plan, applicable
official guidance, and approved study metadata before defining datasets.
